rv.q: Curtains ends up as a perfectly likeable, undeniably clever pastiche that doesn't entirely solve the mystery of why it should take the best part of three hours to get the job done.
There are worse ways of killing time when you're in a holiday humour, but can you live without it? You betcha.

Jason Manford leads an exquisite cast in Curtains - an all-singing-all dancing whodunnit enough to remedy any pre-Christmas crises. Hear ye, Hear ye: the Wydham’s Theatre has in its possession, an antidote to all your Christmas crises.

cn.t: Critics find this knowing Broadway pastiche likeable and cleverly crafted, with energetic direction and choreography, though some question whether its charms justify the lengthy runtime.
